title: (No AI) “We’re not doing 30 bets a year”: Vijay Pande on betting small after running $4 billion at a16z
dc:creator: Connie Loizos
content: Vijay Pande — who left a16z's roughly $4 billion biotech practice last year to start the much smaller, AI-native VZVC — talks about why biology is finally shifting from a "discovery" science to an "engineering" one, why clinical trials are still brutally expensive, and why he thinks open, shared datasets (not walled-off ones) are what will actually let AI transform medicine.

title: (No AI) Sony Music and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![Anthropic logo on an orange and grey background.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/01/STK269_ANTHROPIC_2_A.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Sony Music and Warner Chappell have [filed suit against Anthropic](https://www.musicbusinessworldwide.com/now-sony-music-publishing-and-warner-chappell-sue-anthropic-in-multi-billion-dollar-lawsuit-one-of-the-largest-and-most-blatant-ongoing-thefts-of-intellectual-property-in-history/) in the US District Court for the Northern District of California seeking damages for "tens of thousands" copyrighted works. The companies are asking for up to $150,000 per work, plus up to $25,000 for each instance when identifiable copyright data was stripped. In total, the damages could amount to several billion dollars if a court finds in Sony and Warner's favor and awards the maximum amount.

This is just the latest high-profile suit against Anthropic, which recently settled a suit [brought by the publishing industry](https://www.theverge.com/2024/8/20/24224450/anthropic-copyright-lawsuit-pirated-books-ai) for [$1.5 billion](https://www.theverge.com/anthropic/773087/anthropic-to-pay-1-5-billion-to-authors-in-landmark-ai-settlement). It's also [faced](https://www.theverge.com/2025/1/3/24334866/anthropic-claude-music-publishers-lyric-copyright-lawsuit-deal) [multiple](https://www.theverge.com/2023/10/19/23924100/universal-music-sue-anthropic-lyrics-copyright-katy-perry) [lawsuits](https://www.musicbusinessworldwide.com/umg-concord-and-abkco-sue-anthropic-for-3bn-in-what-could-be-single-largest-non-class-action-copyright-case-in-us-history/) from …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/986438/sony-music-warner-chappell-anthropic-lawsuit-copyright)

title: (No AI) Musicians-turned-detectives are hunting for AI grifters
author: Charles Pulliam-Moore
content:
![A digital illustration depicting Nihil Young and Max “H4RRIS” Harris.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/268714_finding_and_shaming_AI_grifters_CVirginia.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,85.33125,89.314310632479)

As [audio-focused generative tools](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/979345/suno-studio-2-0-midi-chatbot-custom-effects) and platforms have [gotten more sophisticated](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/976636/suno-will-start-scanning-outputs-for-copyright-infringment), the internet has become increasingly filled with [AI-generated music](https://www.billboard.com/music/rb-hip-hop/tyga-admits-ai-starface-album-1236311004/) whose melodies and vocals are algorithmically derived from the work of human artists. While some of the people pumping out this kind of content [immediately own up to using AI](https://www.npr.org/2025/06/17/nx-s1-5431544/timbaland-ai-music-suno-stage-zero-tata-generative), others have [denied using the technology](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/976801/fenix-flexin-rubberz-ai-song-treblo) until increasing public scrutiny [forced them to tell the truth](https://ca.rollingstone.com/music/fenix-flexin-admits-use-ai-rubberz/).

For musicians - especially those creating art in technologically-focused spaces like electronic dance music - the increasingly complicated question of what is "real" and what isn't feels particularly urgent and personal …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/985866/h4rris-nihil-young-edm-suno-ai)
